collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — BEYOND THE HORIZON, EVENTS 081 to 130 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more speculative branching events continuing "Isola — Beyond the Horizon" (001-080), in the same format: EVENT nnn — TITLE, SETUP, choices A/B/C, two mutually exclusive outcomes per choice, and an optional "Content note:".

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: Struggling to describe a feeling, a poet wonders whether distant languages might have words that Isolans have never needed.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Struggling to describe a feeling, (name1), a poet, wonders whether distant languages might have words that Isolans have never needed.

choices.label: Imagine Words for the Same Feelings.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The poet invents a word for "the smell of rain on hot stone"; it catches on.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A scholar points out that distant people might lack words Isolans use every day, like the many names for ripe fruit.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A grandparent suggests that love, worry and boredom might have names everywhere.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A healer wonders whether some feelings go unnamed everywhere, and whether that matters.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The village creates a word for "the moment before laughter"; children use it constantly.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: Nobody can agree on a word, and the poet decides some feelings are better left unnamed.
